product_one_liner.value: Appspace is a workplace experience platform for organizations and their employees that unifies employee communications, digital signage, intranet, space reservations, and visitor management.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog covers workplace strategy, employee communications, and product news; no qualifying engineering blog with two engineer-authored implementation posts was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete public board lists seven openings, none with a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title; the Security Architect role does not qualify.

model_provider.value: Microsoft Azure OpenAI / Microsoft Foundry and Google Gemini / Vertex AI
model_provider.notes: Public materials identify Microsoft and Google as AI providers and allow customers to connect their own supported models; the default model’s exact version is not disclosed.

compliance_certs.notes: GDPR is a claimed regulatory compliance framework, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: Accel-KKR investment announced September 21, 2023; the USD amount was not disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding announcement was September 21, 2023, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window; the 2025 Igloo acquisition was not a funding round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Business Development Representative opening in the United Kingdom; the current board also lists account executive openings.

launched_6mo.notes: Introduced Bring Your Own Model on June 16, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On March 19, 2026, Appspace announced Eric Daggett joining as Chief Sales Officer and Dan Ward joining as Chief Technology Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sales-development systems are named in the BDR posting; additional CRM/support services are named in the subprocessor list.
